# Lumen Learning Courses

> Educational technology platform providing LTI-integrated course management solutions for community colleges, technical colleges, and universities.

Lumen Learning Courses serves as the integration hub connecting educational institutions with Lumen's course content through LTI (Learning Tools Interoperability) consumer endpoints. The platform enables seamless course delivery across various LMS platforms including Canvas, D2L, and Schoology for dozens of partner institutions nationwide.

## Key Topics

- LTI Integration
- Course Management
- Educational Platform
- Community Colleges
- Learning Management Systems
- Canvas LMS
- D2L Brightspace
- Schoology
- University Partnerships
- Educational Technology
- LTI Consumer
- Institutional Integration
- Open Educational Resources
- Course Delivery Platform

## LMS Platform Integrations

- [Schoology](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/schoology): Schoology LMS integration configuration for Lumen courses
- [Big Bend Community College Canvas](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/big-bend-community-college-canvas): Big Bend Community College Canvas LMS integration platform
- [Hagerstown Community College D2L](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/hagerstown-community-college-hagerstown-community-college-d2l): Hagerstown Community College D2L LMS integration page

- [Rio Hondo](https://courses.lumenlearning.com/lti_consumer/rio-hondo): LTI consumer integration page for Rio Hondo college partnership
